page.overview:
Who is Dojo?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Dojo was introduced in the Ninja Force subset of Real American Hero toys in 1992. ----

Appearance: tanned skin; bald on top with black ponytail, mustache, and goatee; yellow goggles; blue shirt with yellow straps, half-gloves, and sash on waist; white pants; blue and yellow boots

Accessories: medium blue sword with long hilt and angled tip; kusari-gama composed of a medium blue sickle and counterweight attached with black string; black figure stand.
